name: Multi Terminal Conductor
description: MT Conductor: a small standalone Windows app (.NET 8 WinForms + WebView2) that gives one overview card per MultiTerminal project, open or not, using only MT's public REST API on localhost:5050.
changeLog:
## v0.1.1 - 2026-11-25
- Card button says "Switch to" when the project is open in MT, "Open" otherwise, from MT's open-state (#103) [Task #d54f0748]
- Follow-ups: shared gh/git runner from absolute PATH only, PR source and "yours" shown on hover, PR fault and gh-missing warnings, hover lists behind the numbers, clearer disabled buttons, Open capability flag and pid refresh [Task #908c8693]
- Open focuses a project's pane or launches it through MT's Open endpoint (ClarionLive/multiterminal#103) [Task #42035abd]
- Remote mode pill shows when it last changed; the remote-mode toggle was dropped after review, so Carry on and Pause wait for an MT change [Task #5a233e54]
- Phase 1: one card per MT project with PM, where you left off, tasks, PRs, questions and the "needs you" dot [Task #51459adc]
